create.name: Paula Radziszewska
create.bio:
Paula Radziszewska is a Polish yoga teacher who has lived in Scotland for close to two decades and teaches from Edinburgh, where she goes by Paula in Scotland. She began teaching in 2018 after slower forms of yoga helped her through her own burnout, stress and an unexpected bereavement. Her training spans yin, restorative, trauma-informed and inclusive yoga as well as yoga nidra; she names Judith Hanson Lasater for restorative work, Uma Dinsmore-Tuli for yoga nidra and Peter Levine among her teachers.

Her classes are built around rest rather than effort: long supported holds, guided relaxation, quiet and attention to how each body actually feels, with props adjusted so that nobody has to force a shape. She describes herself as neurodivergent and keeps her rooms dim and low in stimulation. She runs Pokój Spokój, a small Polish-language online studio with live Zoom sessions and a library of recordings, teaches a weekly Polish-speaking class in Edinburgh, and leads workshops in Poland and rest retreats abroad, having guided more than 29 retreats so far. Her YouTube channel carries free yin, restorative and yoga nidra sessions in Polish.

courses.title: Pokój Spokój online studio
courses.description: Her Polish-language online studio: live yin, restorative and yoga nidra sessions on Zoom several times a month, plus a library of recorded practices from ten-minute pauses to full sessions. Members also get short themed practice series.

courses.title: Polish-language yoga class in Edinburgh
courses.description: A weekly 70-minute class taught in Polish on Friday evenings in an Edinburgh studio, drawing on yin yoga, restorative yoga and yoga nidra. No experience is needed and mats and props are provided.

sprint.tier_evidence: YouTube @paulainscotland_yoga 1,050 subscribers (YouTube Data API, 12 Nov 2026); Instagram @paulainscotland_yoga not fetched (off limits) → ~1k readable → local_hero
flags: Health restore (owner's 12 Nov rule): her main pitch is rest, stress, burnout and tiredness (wellbeing). Her English page /scheduleinenglish, in her own copy, says yoga nidra lowers blood pressure and improves heart health and reduces symptoms of depression; the items sold on that page are left out (see left_out), the page is not linked.

She says she trained in yoga nidra for burnout, long COVID and chronic stress and works with Rest Repair Recover, a platform for people recovering from long COVID (Polish workshop page). No COVID item is listed and the bio does not mention it; owner may prefer to drop her under the COVID rule.
Scope: the old skip judged her work wellbeing yoga rather than spiritual teaching; listed under yoga, meditation and mindfulness. Owner may disagree.
Most of her site and all but one video are in Polish; video titles kept in Polish as published.
Email info@yogawithpaula.uk is a mailto link on the Edinburgh class page; a gmail address also appears there.
